# The C encoder's two CBR jobs as register words: the intra job and the
# next P job, in window order, addresses included (those differ per
# process). The I job is the fixed-QP job plus the thirty rate-control
# fields, so rebuilding those fields has to reproduce these words.
# Regenerate with: REFRESH=1 scripts/board_h264_rc_capture.sh
